To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

regioselectively curdlan ester is an effective approach to modulating the molecular structure of curdlan and the ester groups at C2, C4 and C6 positions of curdlan play the decisive role on its thermal and mechanical properties.

regioselectively substitution on secondary hydroxoyl groups at C2, C4 position of curdlan can be used to regulate the crystallinity of curdlan and the esters groups substituted on primary hydroxyl group at C6 position of curdlans have little influence on the melting behavior of curdlan.
the ester substitution on secondary hydroxyll groups at C2/C4 positions play the key role in the crystallization behavior and mechanical properties of curldan esters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of curdlan heteroglycan with different ester substituents on the primary and secondary hydroxy groups.
the synthesis and characterization of regiospecifically substituted curdlan ester derivatives.
the synthesis of regioselective substituted curdlan ester and its application in the development of biodegradable materials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the substitution of the ester group on the secondary hydroxyl group at the C2 and C 4 positions plays a decisive role in the thermal and mechanical properties of curdlan esters.
the ester group substituted on secondary hydroxy at C2 and/or C4 position is the main factor to control the melting behavior and crystal formation of the curdlan ester.
the ester group substituted on the secondary hydroxyl group is a key parameter to control the crystalline formation and mechanical properties of curdlan esters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the regioselectively 2,4-O-esterified curdlan derivatives with different ester substituent groups on secondary hydroxil groups are potential biodegradable polymers for the application in biomedical and packaging field.
the esterification of curdlan with different ester reagents can be applied to the preparation of curdlan heteroe esters with various ester groups on different hydroxyl groups.
the esterification of curdlan is a useful method to control crystallization and to improve mechanical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the molecular structures and properties of regioselective curdlan derivatives could be designed by the combination of regioselectivity and the type of ester group.
the esterification of secondary hydroxyls at C2 and/or C4 positions can significantly improve the mechanical properties of regioselectivly substituted curdlan ester.
the esters with different groups on secondary hydroxys at C2 and/or C4 positions have a significant effect on the crystallinity, thermal and mechanical behaviors of the esterified curdlans.
